tag.name: accordion
tag.note: A column of folding sections, one heading each, for a pane with more in it than fits.

tag.name: accordion_tab
tag.note: One folding section of an accordion: a heading that opens and closes, and whatever is under it.

tag.name: asset_filtered_inv_panel
tag.note: An inventory panel showing only one kind of asset, for a picker that wants animations or sounds and nothing else.

tag.name: avatar_icon
tag.note: One resident's picture, fetched by key and drawn at whatever size it is given.

tag.name: avatar_list
tag.note: A list of residents, each row a picture, a name and whatever the list was told to show beside them.

tag.name: badge
tag.note: A small count or mark placed on the corner of the thing it is about, drawn over its holder rather than inside it.

tag.name: block_list
tag.note: The residents this account has blocked, and what each block covers.

tag.name: button
tag.note: A thing to press. Its label, its image or both say what pressing it does.

tag.name: chat_editor
tag.note: The line chat is typed into: history on the arrow keys, and it grows as what is being written does.

tag.name: chat_history
tag.note: What has been said, in order, with names, times and links made clickable.

tag.name: check_box
tag.note: One answer that is yes or no, with the question written beside it.

tag.name: chiclet_notification
tag.note: The little marker in the toolbar for a notification waiting to be read.

tag.name: chiclet_offer
tag.note: The marker for an offer of an object or a folder, waiting to be taken or declined.

tag.name: chiclet_panel
tag.note: The strip the chiclets sit in, which shares its room out between them as they come and go.

tag.name: chiclet_script
tag.note: The marker for a script asking this account for something.

tag.name: color_field
tag.note: A colour written the way a file writes one: a swatch, the name it is called in the colour table, and the four numbers behind it.

tag.name: color_picker
tag.note: A wheel, a value slider and the numbers, for choosing a colour rather than naming one.

tag.name: color_swatch
tag.note: A block of one colour that opens a picker when it is clicked.

tag.name: color_wheel
tag.note: The hue and saturation of a colour, chosen by pointing at it.

tag.name: combo_box
tag.note: One choice out of a list, shown closed until it is asked to open.

tag.name: console
tag.note: Lines of text that arrive, are read and fade, for what the viewer is saying rather than what anybody typed.

tag.name: container_view
tag.note: A view whose only job is to hold others: it draws nothing of its own.

tag.name: context_menu
tag.note: The menu a right click opens, over the thing that was right-clicked.

tag.name: conversation_log_list
tag.note: Every conversation this account has had, most recent first.

tag.name: conversation_view_participant
tag.note: One person in a conversation, with what they can do in it and what they are doing.

tag.name: conversation_view_session
tag.note: One conversation in the list, with the people in it folded under it.

tag.name: curve_editor
tag.note: A curve dragged by its points, for a setting whose value is a shape rather than a number.

tag.name: debug_view
tag.note: What the viewer draws over the world for a developer: the stats, the outlines and the rest.

tag.name: dnd_button
tag.note: A button that also takes a drop, so a thing can be dragged onto what it does.

tag.name: drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes what is dragged onto it and says what it took.

tag.name: emoji_complete
tag.note: The list that offers emoji as they are typed, and puts the chosen one in.

tag.name: expandable_text
tag.note: Text cut to the room there is, with a way to open the rest of it.

tag.name: favorites_bar
tag.note: The landmarks kept on the bar, in the order they were put there.

tag.name: favorites_inventory_panel
tag.note: The favourites folder as an inventory panel, for the bar to be filled from.

tag.name: filter_editor
tag.note: A line that narrows a list to what carries what is typed, with a way to clear it.

tag.name: flags_field
tag.note: A set of independent answers written as one word with bars between them, shown as one box each.

tag.name: flat_list_view
tag.note: A list whose rows are views rather than text, kept in one flat column.

tag.name: floater
tag.note: A window of its own: a title bar, what is in it, and whatever it is allowed to do about being moved, sized or closed.

tag.name: floater_view
tag.note: What every floater is a child of, and what decides which of them is in front.

tag.name: flyout_button
tag.note: A button with a menu on its edge: press it for the usual thing, open it for the rest.

tag.name: folder_view_item
tag.note: One row of a tree: an icon, a name, and whatever is folded under it.

tag.name: font_field
tag.note: A font written the way a file writes one: the name from fonts.xml, its size and its style.

tag.name: fs_virtual_trackpad
tag.note: A pad dragged in two directions at once, for a value that is a point rather than a number.

tag.name: group_drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes a group dragged onto it.

tag.name: group_icon
tag.note: One group's picture, fetched by key.

tag.name: group_list
tag.note: The groups this account is in, each row a picture and a name.

tag.name: hex_editor
tag.note: Bytes as bytes: the offsets down the side, the values across, and the text of them beside.

tag.name: hint_popup
tag.note: A pointer at something on the screen, with a line saying what it is.

tag.name: icon
tag.note: A picture and nothing else: it does not take a click.

tag.name: icons_combo_box
tag.note: A combo box whose choices are pictures rather than words.

tag.name: inbox_folder_view_folder
tag.note: One folder of the received-items inbox.

tag.name: inbox_folder_view_item
tag.note: One item of the received-items inbox, with whether it has been looked at.

tag.name: inbox_inventory_panel
tag.note: The received-items inbox as an inventory panel.

tag.name: inventory_gallery_item
tag.note: One inventory item as a picture with its name under it, for the gallery rather than the tree.

tag.name: inventory_link_replace_drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes an inventory item, for saying which one a set of links should point at instead.

tag.name: inventory_panel
tag.note: Inventory as a tree: folders that open, items that can be dragged, and a filter over the whole of it.

tag.name: joystick_quat
tag.note: A control dragged in two directions that answers with a rotation.

tag.name: joystick_rotate
tag.note: The camera turned about what it is looking at.

tag.name: joystick_slide
tag.note: The camera moved sideways and up without turning.

tag.name: joystick_track
tag.note: The camera moved along its own line of sight.

tag.name: joystick_turn
tag.note: The camera turned where it stands.

tag.name: labeled_back_button
tag.note: A back button that says where back is.

tag.name: layout_panel
tag.note: One pane of a layout stack: it says how much room it wants and whether it gives any up.

tag.name: layout_stack
tag.note: Panes in a row or a column, sharing the room out between them and giving a bar to drag where two of them meet.

tag.name: line_editor
tag.note: One line of text to type in, with what it will take and what it will not.

tag.name: list_view
tag.note: Rows in a column, each a view of its own.

tag.name: loading_indicator
tag.note: A mark that says something is still coming, and nothing about how much of it.

tag.name: locate
tag.note: A mark drawn where something is, for pointing at a place.

tag.name: location_input
tag.note: The address bar: where this account is, and somewhere else to type.

tag.name: menu
tag.note: A list of things that can be done, opened from a bar, a button or a right click.

tag.name: menu_bar
tag.note: The row of menus along the top of a window, which also answers that window's keyboard shortcuts.

tag.name: menu_button
tag.note: A button that opens a menu instead of doing one thing.

tag.name: menu_holder
tag.note: What open menus are drawn in, above everything else in the window.

tag.name: menu_item
tag.note: One line of a menu.

tag.name: menu_item_call
tag.note: A menu line that does something when it is chosen.

tag.name: menu_item_check
tag.note: A menu line that is on or off, and says which.

tag.name: menu_item_separator
tag.note: A line across a menu, to say the things above it and below it are different things.

tag.name: menu_item_tear_off
tag.note: The line at the top of a menu that takes the menu out into a window of its own.

tag.name: multi_floater
tag.note: A window holding other windows as tabs, each of which can be torn back out.

tag.name: multi_slider
tag.note: One track with more than one thumb on it, for a set of values in the same range.

tag.name: multi_slider_bar
tag.note: The track a multi slider's thumbs run along, without the numbers beside it.

tag.name: name_box
tag.note: A resident's name, fetched by key and filled in when it arrives.

tag.name: name_editor
tag.note: A resident's name that can also be typed into.

tag.name: name_list
tag.note: A list of names fetched by key, which fill themselves in as they arrive.

tag.name: net_map
tag.note: The little map: this region and its neighbours, with what is on them.

tag.name: notification_list_view
tag.note: Notifications as a list, in the order they arrived.

tag.name: outfit_gallery_item
tag.note: One outfit as a picture with its name under it.

tag.name: output_monitor
tag.note: Whether a resident is speaking, and how loudly.

tag.name: panel
tag.note: A region of a window: something to put things in, with a background and a border if it wants them.

tag.name: panel_camera_item
tag.note: One camera preset as a row that can be chosen.

tag.name: panel_container
tag.note: A panel holding other panels, one of which is showing.

tag.name: panel_inventory_object
tag.note: One inventory object shown as a panel rather than as a row.

tag.name: places_inventory_panel
tag.note: Landmarks as an inventory panel.

tag.name: profile_drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes a resident dragged onto it.

tag.name: profile_image
tag.note: A profile picture, with a way to change it where that is allowed.

tag.name: progress_bar
tag.note: How far along something is, when that is known.

tag.name: property_grid
tag.note: One row per field of a thing, with the editor each field's type asks for, under headings.

tag.name: pull_button
tag.note: A button with a menu that opens by pulling it in a direction.

tag.name: radio_group
tag.note: One answer out of a few, all of them shown at once.

tag.name: recent_inventory_panel
tag.note: What has arrived in inventory lately, newest first.

tag.name: script_editor
tag.note: Script text, with its keywords coloured, its lines numbered and its errors pointed at.

tag.name: scroll_bar
tag.note: The bar that says how much of something is being seen and moves what part of it that is.

tag.name: scroll_container
tag.note: A window onto something bigger than itself, with bars for reaching the rest.

tag.name: scroll_list
tag.note: Rows and columns of text, sorted by a heading, with one or more of them chosen.

tag.name: scrolling_panel_list
tag.note: Panels stacked in a column that scrolls.

tag.name: search_combo_box
tag.note: A line to search in, with what has been searched for before under it.

tag.name: search_editor
tag.note: A line to search in, with the button that starts the search.

tag.name: settings_drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes an environment setting dragged onto it.

tag.name: simple_text_editor
tag.note: Text to type into, over more than one line, with nothing coloured.

tag.name: single_folder_inventory_panel
tag.note: One inventory folder at a time, rather than the whole tree.

tag.name: slider
tag.note: A number chosen by dragging along a track, with the number written beside it.

tag.name: slider_bar
tag.note: The track a slider's thumb runs along, without the number beside it.

tag.name: snapshot_floater_view
tag.note: What the snapshot window is drawn in, so it can be placed against the picture being taken.

tag.name: sound_drop_target
tag.note: A region that takes a sound dragged onto it.

tag.name: spinner
tag.note: A number typed in or stepped by its arrows, between the two ends it is given.

tag.name: split_button
tag.note: A button with a second half that offers the other things it could do.

tag.name: stat_bar
tag.note: One measurement over time, drawn as a bar or a line, with what it is called and what it is in.

tag.name: stat_view
tag.note: A group of measurements shown together, which folds away as one.

tag.name: sun_moon_trackball
tag.note: Where the sun and the moon are, dragged about the sky rather than typed.

tag.name: tab_container
tag.note: Pages sharing one region, with a strip of tabs saying which is showing.

tag.name: teleport_history_menu_item
tag.note: One place this account has been, as a menu line that goes back there.

tag.name: text
tag.note: Words to read: it is not typed into and it is not pressed.

tag.name: text_chat
tag.note: What has been said in chat, laid out for reading rather than for editing.

tag.name: text_editor
tag.note: Text to type into, over more than one line, with what it will take and what it will not.

tag.name: texture_picker
tag.note: A picture chosen out of inventory, with a swatch of what is chosen.

tag.name: thumbnail
tag.note: A small picture standing for a larger thing, with a way to change it.

tag.name: toggleable_menu
tag.note: A menu that closes when the thing that opened it is pressed again.

tag.name: tool_tip
tag.note: What is said about the thing under the pointer when it has rested there.

tag.name: toolbar
tag.note: Buttons in a strip, which can be arranged and can carry their labels or not.

tag.name: toolbar_view
tag.note: The four edges a toolbar can be docked to, and what is docked where.

tag.name: tooltip_view
tag.note: What tool tips are drawn in, above everything else in the window.

tag.name: ui_ctrl
tag.note: Anything that can be interacted with: it can take focus, hold a value and say when that value changed.

tag.name: view
tag.note: The plainest thing there is: a rect, children, and the rules for where it goes when its parent changes size.

tag.name: view_border
tag.note: A line round a region, for saying where one thing ends and the next begins.

tag.name: wearable_items_list
tag.note: What can be worn, as a list, with what is worn already marked.

tag.name: web_browser
tag.note: A page rendered in the viewer, with what it is allowed to do.

tag.name: window_shade
tag.note: A panel that rolls down over what it covers to say something about it.

tag.name: xy_vector
tag.note: Two numbers chosen at once by pointing at where they meet.

tag.name: dock_panel
tag.note: A pane that knows it can be in a window of its own, and how to come back.

tag.name: empty_state
tag.note: What a pane says when there is nothing in it: what is missing, how to get some, and the one thing that would fix it.

tag.name: follows_control
tag.note: Which edges of its parent an element is tied to, drawn as the four struts and two springs that says.

tag.name: history_list
tag.note: Everything done to a document, newest first, with a mark where the present is.

tag.name: jump_bar
tag.note: The path to where you are, each step of it offering the steps it could have been.

tag.name: quick_open
tag.note: A few letters and a ranked list, for reaching a thing by name rather than by looking for it.

tag.name: scope_bar
tag.note: A query written as a sentence: fixed words, dropdowns, and one field for what is looked for.

tag.name: specimen_list
tag.note: A list whose rows carry the things themselves rather than words about them.

tag.name: tab_strip
tag.note: The documents a window holds, one tab each over the one it shows, with a dot for unsaved work and a way to close each.

tag.name: time
tag.note: A time of day, chosen as hours and minutes with a pair of arrows and typed if the file allows it.

tag.name: inspector
tag.note: A tooltip that is a panel: what a hover says when it has more to say than one line.

tag.name: radio_item
tag.note: One choice of a radio group, written as a child of the group it belongs to.

tag.name: scroll_column_header
tag.note: The heading over one column of a scroll list, which sorts by it and can be dragged to widen it.

tag.name: textbase
tag.note: The parameters every text widget shares, named so that a file may configure one it does not otherwise reach.

tag.name: avatar_list_item
tag.note: One resident's row in a list of them: a picture, a name, and the buttons the list was told to show.

tag.name: inventory_list_item
tag.note: One inventory item's row, with its icon, its name and whatever the list puts beside them.

tag.name: wearable_outfit_list_item
tag.note: One outfit's row in My Outfits, with what wearing it would take.

tag.name: clothing_list_item
tag.note: One worn piece of clothing, with the buttons that edit, move and take it off.

tag.name: bodyparts_list_item
tag.note: One worn body part, which can be replaced but never simply taken off.

tag.name: deletable_wearable_list_item
tag.note: A worn thing with a button to take it off, for the lists where that is allowed.

tag.name: dummy_clothing_list_item
tag.note: A place in the list for a kind of clothing nothing is worn for, greyed, with the way to add some.
